mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_home_module (type, title, config, sort_order, status, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) VALUES (#{type}, #{title}, #{config}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})
